title: VideoGame Platform · MVP journey proxies
description: Operational API-call proxies, not visitors or sessions. Catalogue totals/means and HTTP error/absence counts are observed process totals; HTTP activity is an estimated rate. Contracted GET rating absence is visible separately from actionable failures.

panels.title: Journey API activity by route / method
panels.description: Estimated API requests/second by method and route over the rate window: browsing, search, details and personal-rating reads/writes/deletes. These are calls, not people or a conversion funnel; cached responses can avoid calls. Sparse first calls can be missed by a rate.

panels.title: Journey actionable HTTP failures · process
panels.description: Exact observed error-response totals since process start, by route, method and outcome. Includes the first exported error; no rate extrapolation. Excludes only GET /me/ratings/{gameId} 404: the approved scoped-absence response consumed as null by the frontend. GET 401 and PUT/DELETE 404 remain visible. Problem codes are not meter tags: this narrow classification relies on the contract, and is not a selected-range total.

panels.title: Search outcomes · observed process totals
panels.description: Exact cumulative successful search calls with results/zero_results since process start. A registered zero is valid; no request content is collected. This is not unique searches, the number of returned games, or a total for the selected range.

panels.title: Mean items per HTTP 200 release page · process
panels.description: Cumulative returned release-item sum / successful HTTP 200 page count, per view, since process start. The frontend defaults to 12 items, so consistently full pages correctly average 12. A lower mean may reflect a small/last/filtered page or a different requested size. 304 cache hits are not recorded. It is page yield, not catalogue size, distinct games or demand; no universal target applies.

panels.title: Detail reads by eligibility / aggregate · process
panels.description: Exact cumulative successful detail reads (including 304) by global eligibility reason and aggregate availability since process start. Any valid occurred release makes the game eligible, even if another platform/region release is future. A game with only future releases is RELEASE_NOT_OCCURRED. Missing categories are unobserved; no extrapolation or fractional reads. Aggregate available includes a healthy empty rating aggregate.

options.content: These are API-call proxies. Browser cache hits and client-side navigation can avoid calls. **Unique visitors, conversion, retention, session funnels and search terms are unsupported.** Rating ownership and Game IDs are never dimensions. Instant totals/means describe the latest observed application process, not the selected time-range total or durable history. Counters reset on restart; missing series are not invented zeros. GET rating absence is an expected contracted response, displayed separately; write failures remain actionable.

panels.title: Expected unrated-game reads · process GET 404
panels.description: Exact observed routine rating-absence response count since process start for authenticated GET /me/ratings/{gameId}, including the first event. The public detail response cannot supply personal ownership or creation/update preconditions. This is visible separately from actionable failures; not a failed write, unique-user count or selected-range total.
